event_summary: An energetic birthday celebration balanced across all age groups, featuring custom cake artistry, interactive entertainment, and themed dining.

budget_allocations.notes: Party hall booking, themed backdrop, balloon styling, and lighting.
Age-group friendly appetizers, main buffet, and mocktail bar.
Custom tiered theme cake, cupcakes, and allergen-labeled treats.
DJ/emcee, interactive games, and activity zone for all age groups.
Event photographer and personalized party favors for guests.

tasks: Set overall birthday budget and choose the party theme and age-group focus.
Draft initial guest list across kids, teens, adults, and seniors.
Reserve the party venue or rooftop space.
Shortlist cake artists and entertainment hosts.
Book the custom cake baker with theme sketches and flavor choices.
Confirm DJ/emcee and age-appropriate game stations.
Send digital invitations with RSVP and dietary preference questions.
Finalize catering menu including kid-friendly and vegetarian options.
Order themed decor props, signage, and return gift bags.
Confirm final RSVP headcount with caterer and baker.
Prepare music playlist and game prizes.
Schedule delivery and setup windows with all vendors.
Assemble return gift hampers and party props.
Reconfirm cake delivery time and refrigerated storage at the venue.
Complete venue decor setup and audio check 2 hours before guests arrive.
Receive and inspect the custom birthday cake and dessert table.
Host welcome activities, cake cutting ceremony, and group photos.

vendor_checklist.notes: Ensure step-free access and dedicated photo backdrop lighting.
Include finger foods for kids and clearly labeled allergen tags.
Confirm eggless/nut-free options, candles, and cake knife set.
Plan inclusive games suitable for multiple age groups.
Capture candid moments and cake cutting highlights.

decor: Neon LED marquee sign with custom color-blocked balloon garland.
Themed tabletop centerpieces with milestone photo cards from past years.
Dedicated selfie wall with high-contrast props and ring lighting.
food: Build-your-own slider, taco, and chaat station for all age groups.
Signature themed birthday cake paired with matching mini cupcakes.
Sparkling fruit coolers and custom mocktails with edible garnishes.
entertainment: High-energy DJ set mixed with throwback hits for all generations.
Interactive trivia and rapid-fire bingo hosted by the emcee.
Instant polaroid keepsake corner for guests.
activities: Time-capsule memory jar where guests drop wishes and predictions.
Multi-generational team scavenger hunt with themed prizes.
DIY craft or dessert-topping bar for younger guests.
personalized_ideas.invitation_wording: Get ready to celebrate! Join us for an unforgettable birthday party filled with music, laughter, great food, and sweet memories.
